text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the final "Dream Fest," 
public excitement reached an absolute 
fever pitch. It was around then that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Or so my sister says, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"However,
judging by how high-spirited she 
was heading toward the grounds—"
choice_data_list: We'd better go check it out...!
Maybe we should go take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—in the midst of the collapsed 
Umamusume, I found Mejiro Ramonu standing 
gracefully.
choice_data_list: We'd better go take a look...!
We'd better go take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister, what is the meaning of this 
disaster...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I was given an attractive invitation, so 
I simply accepted it."

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "...Haa, haa. As strong as ever, geez..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What I have spent time polishing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...The same goes for you all, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did...! Ever since I lost on 
that show, I've been giving it... 
everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We... and all the other girls grew 
stronger too. Because of your words, 
everyone—
choice_data_list: (These girls, they faced off on th...

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated,
I was pissed off. I just 
ran recklessly, determined to prove them 
all wrong.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And then, before I knew it, I had fans, 
and the whole racing world was getting 
more and more excited—

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
......Even I caught on eventually. Ah,
you 
really played me good.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Was it, 'Allow me to guide you'? 
Seriously, what a total wicked woman."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm grateful for it now, though.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Win the 'Dream Fest'. You're supposed to 
be a new legend, right?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Ramonu-san! I'm going to watch 
"Dream Fest"~!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Racing's surprisingly fun! Thanks for 
teachin' me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How strange. Every single one of them, 
nothing but gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Everything Sister says and does stems
from 
her love of racing... I suppose more and 
more people are finally coming to 
understand that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...And yet, are you going to provoke 
everyone at the press conference again?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's not enough yet. I know I can 
dedicate even more passion to this."
choice_data_list: It's a race that's definitely wort...
It's a race that's definitely wort...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final 'Dream Fest', which will surely 
be etched in legend.
choice_data_list: It's a race that's worth every bit...
It's a race that's worth every bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was as close as could be to the 
ultimate race, and surely,
it would become 
an unforgettable one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...I will dedicate a priceless gem 
of a victory to you."
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!
I'm really looking forward to it, ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...I love you.
